source.title: Timer deducted 10 seconds off of total time while running
source.content:
During a solve, a competitor's timer malfunctioned and the tens-place digit of the timer suddenly changed from 1 to 0, thus causing 10 seconds to be deducted from the total time while the timer was running. The final recorded result of the attempt was consistent with the time shown on the malfunctioned timer. No extra attempt was given.

After analyzing the footage utilizing framecounting, and an internal discussion, as well as consulting the WRT, the WRC has decided to **add 10 seconds to the original result** instead of issuing a DNF.

translation.title: 计时器运行时总时间突然减少 10 秒
translation.content:
还原中计时器故障，十秒位突然从 1 变为 0，使运行中的总时间减少 10 秒。最终记录与故障计时器显示一致，没有给予额外尝试。

通过逐帧计时分析视频、内部讨论并咨询 WRT 后，WRC 决定**在原成绩上加回 10 秒**，而非判 DNF。
